words.gloss: the lord of the maritime shore

literal: The cool shore's lord's departure, even before us, beforehand sensed, the bangles.
translation: Even before I could fully realize that the lord of the cool shore had departed, my slipping bangles sensed it first.
modern: குளிர்ந்த கடற்கரைத் தலைவன் நம்மைப் பிரிந்து சென்றதை, நம்மை விட முன்னதாகவே என் கைகளில் உள்ள வளையல்கள் உணர்ந்து கொண்டு கழன்றன.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks of her deep grief over her lover's departure. The lover is addressed as the lord of the cool maritime shore (துறைவன்). Even before her mind could fully process the pain of his separation (நம்மினும் முன்னம் உணர்ந்த), her body reacted instantly to the sorrow. Her arms grew thin from grief, causing her bangles (வளை) to slip off, making it seem as though the bangles knew of the departure before she herself did.
